# Quantum Success, Blueprint to Freedom: full summary

Website: https://www.quantumsuccessblueprint.com/
Founder: Dr Hemani Chaturvedi
Headquarters: Australia (online, with learners in other countries)
Last updated: 19 November 2026

## What it is

Quantum Success is an online personal development platform. It combines a structured, self-paced learning curriculum with individual coaching. The learning is about self-awareness, mindset, personal growth, vitality and leadership. Learners keep lifetime access to the curriculum, so they can revisit lessons and deepen their understanding over time. Individual coaching gives space to reflect, explore insights and consider how to apply the learning in everyday life.

It is voluntary personal development education and coaching. It is not medical or psychological treatment, counselling, a diagnostic service, or a substitute for professional healthcare, legal advice or family dispute resolution. Results are personal and not guaranteed.

## The founder

Dr Hemani Chaturvedi brings close to three decades of professional experience spanning medicine, business consulting, technology, governance, risk, resilience and personal transformation. Her work today embraces trauma-informed spiritual care and chaplaincy, personal development and leadership coaching, and philanthropy. A writer currently working on her debut book, she explores professional boundaries, human vulnerability and practical ways of navigating life's complexities. Her vision is to empower individuals through self-awareness, practical learning and more intentional choices, while honouring each person's unique journey.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/drhemanichaturvedi/

## Programme levels

### Foundation level
The online program is focussed on mindset, awareness and personal transformation, designed for those ready to invest in themselves.
- 17 parts, foundational modules (17 days, 1 hour each approximately)
- 8 parts, immersion modules (2 weeks, 2 hours each approximately)
- 5 coaching sessions with Dr Hemani Chaturvedi (45 minutes each)
- Actionable strategies and reflective exercises
- Lifetime access, self-paced, learn anytime, anywhere

### Intermediate level
Moves beyond the basics, for long-term growth and self-mastery: transformational learning modules, guided reflections and practical exercises, online coaching sessions, lifetime access.

### Advanced level
Premium experiences combining transformational learning, world-class speakers, meaningful connections and environments that encourage lasting change, in person or in virtual sessions.

## Free 7-day online bootcamp
A free 7-day transformation bootcamp for young adults, offered on the home page.
